entities.summary: Jonathan Albaladejo Santana is a Puerto Rican professional baseball coach and former pitcher who is currently the manager for the Trois-Rivières Aigles of the Frontier League. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Washington Nationals, New York Yankees, and Arizona Diamondbacks, as well in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Yomiuri Giants.
